Method of Attack: Argument injection through associated URI protocol handlers that improperly escape their parameters
Command injection via custom URI schemes (irc:, ircs:, mircurl:) allowing loading of remote configuration files and automatic execution of arbitrary code
Execution of remote scripts via malicious configuration files leading to malware download, user creation, or file deletion
Impacted Systems: mIRC application versions older than 7.55 on Windows
Attack Vector: Maliciously crafted irc: URI links embedded in web pages (e.g., iframe on malicious website)
Phishing, forum posts, or any user-submitted content containing malicious irc: URLs
Indicators of Compromise: Custom irc: URI scheme links such as irc://irc.undernet.org/
Remote MIRC.ini configuration files hosted on attacker-controlled SAMBA servers
Web pages containing iframes that open malicious irc: URLs
